name: My * Sister
source:
This is the debut title by Fleur-soft. Yukito lives with his two cute imoutos Mashiro and Leia, enjoying his school life with them by his side, even as he is tempted by their sweet charms. However, due to a certain incident, they and his kouhai Sora who lives nearby have been more aggressive for his love.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Fleur-soft的首张作品。幸人与他的两个可爱的妹妹Mashiro和Leia住在一起，在他们的陪伴下享受着学校生活，尽管他被他们的甜蜜魅力所诱惑。然而，因为某件事，他们和住在附近的后海空为了他的爱情变得更加激进。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/11/01/november-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
